name: Ouji-sama ga Kureta Koi
source:
"Have you noticed I've been in love with you?" "Me too!"
You've reconnected with three of your childhood friends. What you didn't know was that they're all princes!
What will come of the forbidden love triangle? Will you tie the knot with the prince of your dreams?

[translated from [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/prince.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
“你发现我一直喜欢你了吗？”“我也是！”
你与三位青梅竹马重新取得了联系，却不知道他们竟然都是王子！
这段禁忌的三角恋会走向何方？你能与梦中的王子喜结连理吗？

[译自 [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/prince.html]official website[/url]]
